items.title: Synthetic support-lead notes on the off-hours rota
items.excerpt: Synthetic fixture. Off-hours rota agents work evenings and weekends from home, often in dim rooms, on laptops and sometimes on a phone. Agents need the queue, the rota and the macro list in one tool. Nobody has recorded a licence for any typeface for this internal tool.

items.title: Background facts carried from the accepted lean PRD
items.excerpt: Synthetic fixture (from the accepted PRD background): billing tickets had a median first response of 31 hours versus 9 hours for other tickets in October 2026. Only 2 agents are trained on billing.
